comparisons.peer_topic: Risks related to responsible use of AI
comparisons.peer_summary: Issues related to the responsible use of AI may result in reputational, competitive, and financial harm and liability.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD explicitly identify risks associated with the responsible use of AI, stating that issues in this area may lead to reputational, financial, and competitive harm, as well as liability. NVDA highlights these risks generally within its broader regulatory and legal risk section, noting potential reputational or financial harm. AMD provides a nearly identical formulation, adding 'competitive' harm to the list of potential damages, thereby aligning closely on the core concern of misuse leading to multi-faceted business risk.
